ANTIFRAUD / DIAGNOSTICS

Review network and device signals together.

Browser extensions bring diagnostic observations into a service where results can be reviewed alongside the tested environment.

ProjectIPQS Checker
ScopePublic implementation
StackPython · FastAPI · PostgreSQL · Chrome / Firefox

The problem

IP reputation and browser properties describe different parts of a session. Reviewing one score in isolation makes it difficult to tell whether a result reflects the network, the device profile or the diagnostic provider.

My contribution

  • Built a FastAPI backend for fingerprint and IP-quality diagnostic results.
  • Implemented Chrome and Firefox extension workflows for gathering browser-side observations.
  • Organized provider results, device information and recent checks into reviewable interfaces.

How the system works

Browser sessionDiagnostic checkExtensionAPI & storageReview results

Keep browser collection close to the session. Extensions operate in the browser being inspected, while the backend organizes the resulting observations.

Retain provider context. Different diagnostic services report different signals. Their outputs are reviewed with their source rather than treated as a single universal verdict.

Combine network and device evidence. IP reputation, platform properties and rendering characteristics provide complementary information about the environment.

What you can verify

The public repository contains the backend, extension code, setup documentation and interface screenshots. It shows work across Python services, browser extensions and diagnostic reporting.

Source repository

Scope & limitations

Results depend on the diagnostic provider, browser configuration and time of the check. A score does not establish universal compatibility with anti-bot systems, and this portfolio page does not fingerprint its visitors.
